# GENERATED — do not edit. Edit blocklist-strict.txt, then run: python3 tools/build-pihole.py
#
# Pi-hole variant of the blocklist-strict.txt list. Pi-hole gravity supports plain domains
# and the wildcard rule ||domain^ only, so the AdGuard-only parts are handled
# like this:
#   · @@ ... $important exceptions -> pihole/allow.txt (add it as a subscribed
#     allowlist — Pi-hole v6+)
#   · regex rules are omitted (commented where they occur; they need Pi-hole's
#     own regex denylist, which cannot be shipped inside a subscribed list)
# Everything below is the source list minus those parts.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ===== KEEP-WORKING EXCEPTIONS (131) → moved to pihole/allow.txt; add it as a subscribed allowlist =====
# Update chains: never block these even if other lists ever do
# Apex-only: some community TV lists block the bare lgtvsdp.com (second-screen
# base). Start-anchored, so subdomains like rdx2.lgtvsdp.com stay blocked.

# Samsung: update chain + connectivity check + clock sync

# Samsung: TV Plus streaming + app store / app-auth service layer

# Samsung: config service, liveness ping, account auth, app store, store icons,
# boot liveness probe, remote support, TV Plus EPG/UI images, account sync

# Hisense (VIDAA): updates, store, DRM, launcher, account, voice, messaging,
# time sync, casting receiver

# Vizio: SmartCast API/CDN/registration/config, OS update, NTP (hardcoded in
# firmware — blocking causes clock drift then TLS failures), playback, EPG,
# catalog, voice search, identity

# Roku: device/cloud API, clock, artwork, channel store, Roku Pay, OS updates,
# boot config, EPG/navigation, DRM/playback, voice engine, mobile pairing.
# NOTE: never add an apex `@@||roku.com^` exception — it would unblock the
# telemetry/ad subtrees blocked above.

# Fire TV: connectivity checks, Appstore (discovery/search/install/licences),
# Alexa, registration, Prime Video, OTA updates, NTP, app-launch rows

# Philips: device auth, EPG, Titan OS app/API backends, Hue bridge interface

# Xiaomi: app store, OTA, account, EPG, video CDN, Mi Home/remote, auth

# Panasonic: app-start hosts ("No internet connection" otherwise)

# Not DNS-blockable (handle at router/firewall if wanted):
# - LG hardcoded OTA fallback IP 156.147.69.32:8080
# - TV DoH/DoT bootstrap to 8.8.8.8 / 1.1.1.1 on tcp:443 + tcp/udp:853
#   (Tizen/SmartCast/VIDAA sets are known to ignore DHCP DNS — NAT-redirect
#    :53 and drop 443/853 to public resolvers on the TV VLAN for coverage)
#
# Verified 2026-09-22 (Sony+LG, live AdGuard): all KEEP domains resolve
# normally; every blocked entry returns 0.0.0.0; TV traffic covered.
# Verified 2026-09-23 (Samsung + multi-brand, resolution-level): blocked rows
# resolve upstream (so the filter takes effect once enabled), KEEP rows
# resolve; no device of those platforms on this network yet.
